subject.title: fix(ollama): resolve web search secret refs

question: Should `resolveWebSearchProviderCredential` permanently expose provider-supplied normalization and unavailable-configured-ref callbacks through the public Plugin SDK?
rationale: The implementation is correct and well-proven, but accepting callback hooks as external plugin API is a compatibility and ownership choice that code inspection cannot safely make for maintainers.

options.title: Accept the additive hooks
options.body: Keep the optional fields as the shared contract and land the proven Ollama migration.

options.title: Use a narrower result seam
options.body: Replace callbacks with a structured credential-resolution result or a narrower named helper before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept the additive hooks
recommendation.body: Keep the optional fields as the shared contract and land the proven Ollama migration.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged commit introduced the exported resolver and Ollama path this PR extends.
